## 1. Pooled summary

```{r}
thickness_long <- thickness %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("_thickness"),   # adjust
    names_to = "region_full",
    values_to = "z_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure     = str_extract(region_full, "thickness"),
    hemisphere  = str_extract(region_full, "^lh|^rh"),
    region      = str_remove(region_full, "^(lh|rh)_") %>% str_remove("_(thickness)$")
  )

thickness_summary <- thickness_long %>%
  summarise(
    measure = "Thickness",
    n_regions  = n_distinct(region_full),
    n_controls = n_distinct(SubjectID),
    n_z        = n(),
    mean_z     = mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_z       = sd(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_1.96   = mean(abs(z_score) > 1.96, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_2.58   = mean(abs(z_score) > 2.58, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )
```

## 2. Feature table

```{r}
selected_regions <- read.csv("Results/Risk_Factors/Selected_regions_z.csv")
selected_regions <- selected_regions[selected_regions$group=="HC",]
```

```{r}
selected <- c("lh_parstriangularis_area","lh_frontalpole_thickness","lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness","lh_superiorparietal_thickness","rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness","rh_superiorparietal_thickness")

region_summary <- selected_regions %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(selected),
    names_to = "region_full",
    values_to = "z_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(measure = str_extract(region_full, "thickness|area")) %>%
  group_by(region_full, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    n_controls = n_distinct(SubjectID),
    mean_z     = mean(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_z       = sd(z_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_1.96   = mean(abs(z_score) > 1.96, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_2.58   = mean(abs(z_score) > 2.58, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## 3. QQ plots

```{r}
selected_long <- selected_regions %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(selected),
    names_to = "region_full",
    values_to = "z_score"
  )

region_labels <- c("lh_frontalpole_thickness" = "Left frontal pole (CT)",
                   "lh_lateralorbitofrontal_thickness" = "Left lateral orbitofrontal (CT)",
                   "lh_parstriangularis_area" = "Left pars triangularis (SA)",
                   "lh_superiorparietal_thickness" = "Left superior parietal (CT)",
                   "rh_caudalmiddlefrontal_thickness" = "Right caudal middle frontal (CT)",
                   "rh_superiorparietal_thickness" = "Right superior parietal (CT)")

qqplots <- ggplot(selected_long, aes(sample = z_score)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ region_full, ncol = 3, scales = "free", labeller = as_labeller(region_labels)) +
  labs(
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Sample quantiles (control z-scores)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size =10,color = "black")
  )
qqplots 
```
